title: Oister Global launches Rs 600 crore fund to back growth-stage deeptech startups
summary: Oister Global launches Rs 600 crore fund to back growth-stage deeptech startups
detailed: The fund will focus on companies that have moved beyond the technology development stage, have paying customers and are looking to scale production and commercial operations. Through the fund Oister will participate in primary and secondary rounds for these companies and will invest up to Rs 100 cro
